ch0226_00_jupiter/0101_0701_02_10:
Listen. Keep out of Team Galactic and
Master Cyrus’s way.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7101_0701_01_10:
You may not realize it, but Team Galactic is
still operating in secret, even on Pasio.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7101_0701_02_10:
We’re observing the bonds between sync
pairs—how their spirits link.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7101_0701_03_10: All so we can make a complete spirit.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7102_0701_01_10:
It’s up to the commanders and other
members to decide whether to follow
Master Cyrus.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7102_0701_02_10:
I’ll do my own thing, too. Team Galactic’s
just no fun without Master Cyrus around.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7103_0701_01_10:
Someone from Hisui mistook Saturn and Mars
for people they knew.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7103_0701_02_10:
But did they really know people who looked
THAT much like them?
ch0226_00_jupiter/7103_0701_03_10:
I wonder if I have a look-alike somewhere
out there.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7104_0701_01_10:
It seems Master Cyrus has changed slightly
since coming to Pasio.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7104_0701_03_10:
I’m just glad he’s reconsidered his stance on
the human spirit being useless.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7104_0701_04_10:
Without a spirit, my connection with
Master Cyrus would disappear...
ch0226_00_jupiter/7105_0701_01_10:
It’s refreshing being around you,
[Name:PlayerNickname ], since you’re
the polar opposite of Master Cyrus.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7105_0701_02_10:
Master Cyrus tries to keep people at a
distance, but you let anyone in.
ch0226_00_jupiter/7105_0701_03_10:
I wonder if learning more about your kind of
spirit would prove useful to Master Cyrus.
ch0226_00_jupiter/1701_0701_01_10:
I’ll give you this, so stay quiet about Team
Galactic’s activities.
ch0226_00_jupiter/1701_0702_01_10:
I’m giving it to you as a favor, so use it
properly, OK?
ch0226_00_jupiter/2501_0701_01_10:
If you’re so curious about what Team
Galactic is up to, why don’t you join us?
ch0226_00_jupiter/2501_0701_02_10:
I think you joining Team Galactic would be
interesting.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2501_0701_03_10: That’s it, then? I knew you’d refuse.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2501_0702_01_10:
If you have a change of heart, my door’s
always open.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2501_0702_02_10:
I think you’d have good time. You’d be silly
to turn it down.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2511_0701_01_10:
When Trainers are driven to support
a person or Pokémon they believe in,
it gives them strength.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2511_0701_02_10:
I met a boy in Sinnoh who was weak
at first.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2511_0701_03_10:
When we met again on Pasio, he’d become
so strong, I nearly didn’t recognize him.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2511_0702_01_10:
As a sync pair, you and your partner try to
get stronger for one another without any
deception or betrayal.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2511_0702_02_10:
Unwavering trust... It’s similar to what
Master Cyrus idealizes—a complete spirit.
ch0226_00_jupiter/2511_0702_03_10: Maybe that’s why you’re so tough.
ch0226_00_jupiter/3001_0701_01_10:
Morning! I don’t really have time for
chitchat... I’ve got work to do.
ch0226_00_jupiter/3003_0701_01_10:
Never mind what Team Galactic is up to on
Pasio. You just keep quiet and let us do our
work, all right?
ch0226_00_jupiter/3005_0701_01_10:
Go to bed and stay out of our way! I have
a mission to carry out, and you’re cramping
my style.
